svg.title: Before you add a reranker
svg.text: Three checks and the decision, from today's measurements.
EVERY CANDIDATE IS A MODEL RUN
a copy under another title: dropped
an old version, USD 400 not 500: kept (dedupe isn't freshness)
one chunk per document: 3 answers lost
chunk in an employee's pay question
rerank the hybrid's top 3: 13 vs 14 first on test
a gate on its score: 1 answerable refused, 0 of the 5
both: not adopted; the weighted fusion stays
